VR.title: Immersed Says It’s Finally Getting Ready to Ship ‘Visor’ VR Headset
VR.summary: Immersed is set to ship its long-awaited work-focused standalone VR headset, Visor, with shipping timelines confirmed for pre-order customers.

VR.title: Quest's Horizon+ Subscription Added 10 Monthly Hours Of Xbox Games
VR.summary: Meta's Horizon+ subscription now offers 10 monthly hours of cloud streaming for 58 Xbox titles, enhancing its partnership with Microsoft.

VR.title: Mixed Reality Tower Defense Game Cybercore Protocol Out Now In Early Access On Quest
VR.summary: Cybercore Protocol, a mixed reality tower defense game, has launched in Early Access on Quest, inviting players to experience its unique gameplay.

VR.title: Roboquest VR Launches Today On Quest 3 Along With Cross-Platform Co-Op
VR.summary: Roboquest VR has launched on Meta Quest 3, featuring a new cross-platform co-op mode, expanding its multiplayer capabilities.

VR.title: A.R. Rahman Brings His Immersive Music Experiences To Apple Vision Pro
VR.summary: A.R. Rahman has launched ARR Immersive for Apple Vision Pro, offering an innovative app that combines music and performance in immersive formats.

VR.title: VR Action Platformer Hyperstacks Coming To SteamVR This Week
VR.summary: The colorful VR action platformer Hyperstacks is set to release on Steam and Meta Quest, bringing parkour combat to players.

AI.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
AI.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Opus 5, which closely matches the capabilities of its predecessor, Claude Fable 5, amid rising competition in AI.

AI.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
AI.summary: Nvidia and Microsoft have formed the Open Secure AI Alliance to develop open-source AI security tools, responding to increasing threats in the AI landscape.

AI.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
AI.summary: Microsoft has unveiled new AI security tools, claiming they outperform competitors while being more cost-effective.

AI.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
AI.summary: China's Moonshot AI has introduced the Kimi K3 model, which reportedly rivals top US AI systems at a significantly lower cost.

AI.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
AI.summary: Perplexity's Personal Computer tool is now available for Windows, transforming PCs into locally run AI agents.

AI.title: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
AI.summary: Midjourney has acquired the astrology app Co-Star, marking its expansion into a new domain beyond AI-generated imagery.

NFL.title: Jalen Carter, Eagles agree to four-year extension
NFL.summary: Jalen Carter has signed a four-year extension with the Eagles, making him the highest-paid defensive tackle in NFL history.

NFL.title: Vikings sign Brian O'Neill to four-year contract extension
NFL.summary: The Vikings have extended right tackle Brian O'Neill's contract for four more years, solidifying their offensive line.

NFL.title: De'Von Achane set for full practice after offseason shoulder surgery
NFL.summary: Dolphins running back De'Von Achane is set to return to full practice after recovering from offseason shoulder surgery.

NFL.title: Report: Chiefs DE Ethan Downs tore his ACL
NFL.summary: Chiefs defensive end Ethan Downs has suffered a torn ACL, ending his bid to make the team's roster.

NFL.title: Panthers activate Jaycee Horn
NFL.summary: The Panthers have activated cornerback Jaycee Horn, allowing him to return to practice as the season approaches.

NFL.title: Vikings announce signings of running back Jordan Mims, linebacker Jamal Adams
NFL.summary: The Vikings announced the signings of running back Jordan Mims and linebacker Jamal Adams as veterans report to training camp.
